text:
Ajay Patel: FYI escalating Greenline AI onboarding — ingestion keeps failing and SSO is stuck. They've hit trial limits and flagged as at-risk. Handing off to CS for priority handling.
Maria Gomez: Ack, thanks Ajay. Can you paste the error summary and current customer sentiment?
Ajay Patel: Error snippet: `POST /ingest 500 {"error":"oauth redirect mismatch"}`. Tried reconfig + cache clear. Timeline: started 2 days ago, retry yesterday, no luck. Customer asked if this delays launch — they have a renewal conversation in ~6 weeks.
Leo Chen: I can take the SSO debug. Quick note: last config change was the redirect URI appended with `/app`. Repro steps: 1) start SAML flow 2) receive redirect 3) mismatch logged.
Sabrina Ortiz: We should draft a comms plan and executive fallback. Propose: 1) immediate acknowledgement + ETA, 2) daily progress email until resolved, 3) offer short-term workaround + credits if >72h, 4) prep exec note for escalation.
Ajay Patel: Customer tone: polite but anxious, asked for ETA and impact to launch. I'll share the minimal acknowledgement template I sent: 
```
Hi Priya,
Thanks — we see the issue and are prioritizing it. Team estimate: 24h to deliver a workaround, we’ll provide updates every 12 hours. Apologies for the disruption.
— Ajay (Support)
```
Maria Gomez: I'll own the handoff and account comms. Proposed owners: Maria (CS lead), Leo (SE), Sabrina (AM).
OnboardBot: Created CS ticket CS-4827, priority=high, assigned to Maria. 15m sync scheduled tomorrow 10:30am PT.
Sabrina Ortiz: For renewal risk, mark as `watch` and set a 2-week engagement cadence. If unresolved after 72h propose: short-term dedicated instance + 10% credit (needs finance ok).
Ajay Patel: Customer has an exec call on Thursday — they may ask for escalation. Keeping that on the radar.
Maria Gomez: Comms draft — I'll send the initial update in ~30m. Draft below for quick review: 
```
Subject: Greenline AI onboarding status — immediate update
Hi Priya & team,
We’re actively investigating an SSO redirect issue causing ingestion failures. Current plan: engineering will deploy a targeted workaround within 24 hours; we’ll send status updates twice daily. If the workaround extends beyond 72 hours we’ll propose a temporary dedicated instance and credits to limit launch impact.
We appreciate your patience and will follow up at 12:30pm PT.
Best,
Maria (Redwood CS)
```
Leo Chen: I’ll try the redirect fix and post steps/PR in this thread. ETA ~4h.
Sabrina Ortiz: I’ll prepare an exec note template in case they request a higher touch escalation. Maria — can you own the daily progress email?
Maria Gomez: Yes — I’ll take daily updates and post them here and to the customer. Comms checklist I’ll follow: 1) Acknowledge within 1h, 2) Progress email by EOD, 3) Offer credits if >72h, 4) Exec escalation if requested.
Sabrina Ortiz: Also capturing feedback: onboarding docs unclear about SSO redirect format — we should add a note to docs and the quickstart.
OnboardBot: CS ticket CS-4827 updated: next_sync=1887670000, renewal_risk=medium, status=investigating.
Ajay Patel: Handing off to CS — thanks team. I’ll keep monitoring support queue and escalate if anything changes.
Maria Gomez: Got it. We’ll run the comms plan and update this thread after the first check-in. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
